Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied image only in the small white handkerchief held by the foreground player's hand at lower left. Make one tiny bounded cloth repair; preserve the entire rest of this scene.

The story requires ONE identifying mark: a tiny pipe-burn hole at the actual lower-right corner of the white linen handkerchief, CLOSED by a few stitches directly across that same hole. Currently there is a separate dark burn dot higher up on the cloth and a separate black seam lower down. Remove BOTH existing disconnected marks. Paint clean white/off-white linen where the old separate dot was. At the actual corner, show ONE small repaired pipe burn: a tiny brown scorched edge immediately surrounding the tiny CLOSED tear, with two or three dark thread stitches crossing that SAME tear. The stitches must join its edges so that the repair and brown scorch are visibly one little feature, not two marks. No open black hole, no second brown spot, no decorative embroidery or lettering. Keep the white cloth's current shape, folds, size, light, edge and the player's holding hand completely unchanged. This must read as a small mended pipe-burn on the corner, not a new symbol.

Do not redraw any other pixels intentionally: preserve Klim's exact beardless face, short chestnut hair, frightened gaze, pose, brown jacket without pale patch, gray sack slipping on his shoulders, RIGHT ink-stained hand, LEFT bound wrist and abrasion, rope knots and cart wheel, player's hand and sleeve, bowl, forest, moon, cart construction, shadows and framing. Preserve the selected matte restrained graphic-novel linework, washes, palette and existing texture. Do not add characters, injuries, objects, body parts, text, emblems, magic, glare, photorealism or a different lighting treatment. Keep the opaque landscape canvas and original dimensions.
